elevate.move: Break the process-card repetition by introducing an asymmetric overlap — let one card's image bleed into the rail gutter and sit behind the next card's tag, creating depth and a scroll-driven parallax layer that makes the rail feel physical rather than decorative.

Replace uniform fade-up reveals with role-specific entrances: text rises, process images clip-wipe left-to-right matching the rail fill direction, service cards stamp in with a scale pulse echoing the brass-tag press, and the break band holds still as a breath.
